Graduate Programs
Build on your experience and expand what you can do next with graduate education at SMU Lyle. Explore master’s, doctoral and certificate programs designed for engineers and technology professionals at every stage of their careers.
Apply
Request Information
Graduate Events
Your Master's Degree in Engineering, Your Way
Ready to advance your career, deepen your expertise, and increase your earning potential? At SMU Lyle, you can take advantage of our customizable and stackable degrees. Expand your skillset with specialized certificates that build to a master's degree. With Lyle Anywhere® , you choose the learning format that suits your needs.
